'''Sordu Gogg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] operating on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. He worked out of private booth at the [[Custom Stop]], arranging work for [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] ranging from legitimate cargo run to smuggling gigs.<ref name="BSS" />
